tickets.title: Analyze mortgage down-payment liquidity sources
tickets.text: Compare Teacup Comet Bank cash, short-term bond holdings, taxable brokerage sales at Velvet Acorn Custody, and vested Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to fund the remaining down payment on Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's $945,000 Portland townhouse while preserving at least $80,000 in post-closing reserves.
tickets.evidence: Julian asked for a mortgage liquidity source analysis comparing bank cash, short-term bond holdings, taxable brokerage sales, and vested employer shares to fund the remaining down payment while preserving the stated reserve target; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-10-08.

tickets.title: Upload underwriting asset documentation to lender
tickets.text: Upload the most recent Teacup Comet Bank statement and Velvet Acorn Custody brokerage statement to the lender's portal and provide documentation tying the $25,000 earnest money withdrawal to its source account for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's mortgage underwriting.
tickets.evidence: the most recent Teacup Comet Bank statement and Velvet Acorn Custody brokerage statement have not been uploaded, and the underwriter is asking for documentation tying the earnest money withdrawal to the source account; this remains needed by 2025-10-06.

tickets.title: Review cash-flow effect of rate-lock alternatives
tickets.text: Review the cash-flow effect of the updated loan terms' rate-lock alternatives and financing contingency timeline for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk before Julian responds to the mortgage contact.
tickets.evidence: The mortgage contact sent updated loan terms with a rate-lock choice and financing contingency timeline, and Julian wants the cash-flow effect of the lock alternatives reviewed before he responds; the agreed review is due 2025-10-10.

tickets.title: Resolve student loan payment discrepancy in mortgage file
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy between the $640 monthly student loan payment listed on Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's mortgage application and the $410 income-driven payment on Iris's current servicer statement, which affects the debt-to-income calculation for underwriting.
tickets.evidence: the mortgage application lists Iris’s student loan payment as $640 per month, while the current servicer statement provided by Iris shows a $410 income-driven payment, creating a different debt-to-income calculation for underwriting; resolution remains needed by 2025-10-07.

tickets.title: Resolve stale Velvet Acorn Custody aggregation feed
tickets.text: Resolve the stale joint brokerage balance in the Velvet Acorn Custody aggregation feed so the liquidity worksheet reflects the current cash and short-term bond positions available for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's closing.
tickets.evidence: The Velvet Acorn Custody aggregation feed in the planning portal is showing a stale joint brokerage balance, so the liquidity worksheet is not reflecting the current cash and short-term bond positions available for closing; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-10-06.

tickets.title: Coordinate new-home insurance and liability coverage
tickets.text: Coordinate new-home insurance and liability coverage for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's Portland townhouse, replacing the renters coverage currently in place through their policy set.
tickets.evidence: The townhouse purchase changes the household’s property and liability exposure, and the couple has only renters coverage in place through their current policy set; the agreed new-home insurance and liability coordination is due 2025-10-15.

tickets.title: Review tax lots on taxable ETF positions
tickets.text: Review the short-term gain lots and lower-gain long-term lots in Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's taxable ETF positions at Velvet Acorn Custody to identify which holdings are most suitable if brokerage assets are used for closing cash.
tickets.evidence: Lena noted that several taxable ETF positions have both short-term gain lots and lower-gain long-term lots, affecting which holdings may be most suitable if brokerage assets are used for closing cash; the agreed tax-lot review is due 2025-10-09.
